description: Semantic role map for TREC 45-2. Coordinates extracted directly from the live AcroForm widget rects (pdf-lib), same method as api/_assets/trec-20-19-esign-coords.json. Roles/keys/checkbox-meanings derived from viewing the rendered numbered overlay (.tmp/coord-overlays/short-sale-page*.png) against the real printed form text — NOT from the raw AcroForm field names, which are frequently misleading or duplicated (see individual field notes). x_pct/y_pct/w_pct/h_pct are top-left-origin fractions of the page (0-1 is NOT used here — these are percentages 0-100, matching scripts/extract-trec-field-coords.js convention; divide by 100 before feeding into DocuSeal areas[] which expects 0-1 fractions). DATE FIELDS ADDED 2026-09-21 (Carter): buyer1_date, seller1_date — synthetic placement in verified blank space below each role's existing signature widget (no real AcroForm field backs these; see acroform-field-names-lie memory + esign-signature-date-gate.test.js). Coordinates rendered to PNG and visually checked against the real PDF before being added, not guessed. BUYER2/SELLER2 DATE PLACEMENT CHECKED AND REJECTED 2026-09-21 (Carter, per Cole review): no execution block or alternate date-shaped blank exists on this page to use instead (only a mid-document performance-deadline blank in paragraph D, unrelated to signing dates and far from the signature block) -- the footer disclaimer sits too close for any synthetic per-signer date box at any tested size (down to 0.006 of page height). Buyer2/Seller2 stay signature-only on purpose so the gate keeps refusing a 2-buyer/2-seller send on this one form.
